a_revoir.message: Cheryl Smith BTW Florida has a handful of endemic milkweed species you should look into for your garden (a few are even threatened and endangered and as a result are encouraged to be planted for conservation), I would also recommend looking into getting some giant milkweed as despite not being native they provide by far the most amount of food for caterpillars and since they are very similar to common milkweed they are frequently grown by many people in the south and especially in Florida and Hawaii since mature plants can feed 2-3 dozen caterpillars (especially larger caterpillars) so they are great to plant alongside native milkweeds to give larger caterpillars a feast so they don't eat all the native milkweeds and thus starve the smaller caterpillars

a_revoir.message:
It’s also important to know which variety of milkweed…common milkweed ￼(large green leaves) can actually overtake the garden, and beyond, while swamp milkweed (slim, spear shaped leaves) is less invasive, and can add some beauty and interest to a garden.  
DO NOT BUY those lovely to look at, non-native tropical varieties that were popular a few years ago.  They are suspect in promoting the parasitic disease that is causing the monarch decline.  I didn’t see them in the my PA nurseries this year, so that’s a good thing.  
One happy note:  last year I had ZERO visitors.  This summer I raised FIVE, and hopefully there were others that did fine in their natural habitats.

a_revoir.motif: « Are these seeds made for zone 7b? » La correction utile — la zone imprimee est un plancher, pas un plafond — a ete publiee le 4 a 20h, le 5 a 18h et le 5 a 23h (Napa). Quatrieme fois de suite: on s'arrete.

a_revoir.message: Can the milkweed seeds grow at 8000’elevation?
a_revoir.motif: « Can the milkweed seeds grow at 8000' elevation? » L'altitude n'est pas une zone de rusticite et nous n'avons rien de source qui permette de traduire l'une en l'autre. Nous ne l'improviserons pas.

a_revoir.message: Can I just sprinkle the seeds outdoors?
a_revoir.motif: « Can I just sprinkle the seeds outdoors? » Couvert par la reponse publiee ce tir-ci a la personne de la zone 8 (semis d'automne, sol nu, en touffe) et par celle du 5 a 1h sur l'absence de position sourcee quant a la profondeur.

a_revoir.message: So my milkweeds grow naturally in my yard every year but I want to propagate more to encourage the pollinators, what do I do?
a_revoir.motif: « My milkweeds grow naturally… I want to propagate more, what do I do? » Recolte des gousses et semis d'automne: le sujet le plus repete de tout l'arriere, publie six fois depuis le 4 septembre, dont une fois ce tir-ci.

a_revoir.message: Janice Smets Only vet bills I have are yearly check ups and vaccinations. 😉 My dogs aren't stupid. I have milkweed all over in the yard and pasture, yet none of my animals touch it. Animals arent as stupid as you apparently are. Better go hide under the bed. There might be an earthquake, or some other scary thing.
a_revoir.motif: « Animals aren't as stupid as you apparently are. Better go hide under the bed. » Fil chien/toxicite devenu insultant. Nous avons RETRACTE publiquement notre affirmation sur la toxicite le 1er septembre et refuse trois fois d'y revenir dans un sens ou dans l'autre; entrer ici ne ferait qu'attiser une querelle personnelle sur un terrain ou nous n'avons rien de source.

a_revoir.message: Erin Tubb Bet I have less vet bills than you.  Take risks with your life but keep the animals out of your psyche for that lifestyle Erin please.
a_revoir.motif: « Take risks with your life but keep the animals out of your psyche » — l'autre moitie du meme echange, meme motif. Le fil chien/toxicite produit maintenant des attaques personnelles a chaque passage, comme le fil « noxious weed ». DEUXIEME fil conflictuel a signaler pour escalade humaine sur ce billet.

a_revoir.message: Planting approximately 1000 seeds on farm this fall/
a_revoir.motif: « Planting approximately 1000 seeds on farm this fall. » Excellent et parfaitement dans la saison, mais le semis d'automne a ete publie six fois depuis le 4 septembre, dont ce matin a 7h, et le levier du fauchage a l'echelle d'une ferme a ete publie ce matin a 6h pour le paturage.

a_revoir.message: My milkweed now has seed pods and wispy cotton on the top ready to fly off. They land all over. I have milkweed that shows up in pots, flower beds, anywhere they land. When those fly off I will trim them down for next year, and they come back lush. Every time the monarchs strip all leaves from a plant I trim it down and it grows again.
a_revoir.motif: Tres beau commentaire — gousses, soie qui s'envole, semis spontanes partout, rabattage puis repousse, et les monarques qui depouillent les plants qui repoussent ensuite. Conforme a nos faits. Ecarte parce que la repousse apres defoliation a ete publiee le 5 a 7h et que le rabattage automnal reste un trou sans source: nous ne pouvons pas eriger sa pratique en conseil, meme si elle lui reussit.
